rules.title: pantheon.yml platform config
rules.fix: Carry php_version, database version, drush_version and protected_web_paths over into the Dockerfile and nginx config, then delete the file.

rules.title: Pantheon custom upstream config
rules.fix: Upstream updates stop after migration. Track core/contrib updates with Composer (and Renovate or Dependabot) instead.

rules.title: Quicksilver workflow hooks
rules.fix: Quicksilver scripts (deploy, sync_code, clone_database…) need to become Stagecoach post-deploy hooks or GitHub Actions steps.

rules.title: settings.php includes settings.pantheon.php
rules.fix: Remove the include and add settings.stagecoach.php, which reads DB credentials, hash salt and trusted hosts from environment variables.

rules.title: Code reads Pantheon environment variables
rules.fix: Swap PANTHEON_* / PRESSFLOW_SETTINGS checks for a platform-neutral variable (e.g. getenv('STAGECOACH_ENV')).

rules.title: pantheon-systems/drupal-integrations
rules.fix: Remove after cutover. It only scaffolds Pantheon-specific settings files.

rules.title: Pantheon Search (search_api_pantheon)
rules.fix: Set up Solr (in-cluster or hosted) or OpenSearch, point the Search API server at it, and reindex before cutover.

rules.title: Pantheon Advanced Page Cache
rules.fix: Replace with Purge plus a CDN purger (Cloudflare, CloudFront, Fastly) or Varnish with cache-tag invalidation.

rules.title: CI pipelines call Terminus
rules.fix: Replace Terminus deploy steps with an image build and a stagecoach deploy step.

rules.title: settings.php includes Acquia's /var/www/site-php credentials file
rules.fix: Acquia injects database credentials through this include, so the site won't boot without it elsewhere. Read credentials from env vars backed by a Kubernetes Secret.

rules.title: Code reads Acquia AH_* environment variables
rules.fix: Swap AH_SITE_ENVIRONMENT / AH_SITE_GROUP checks for a platform-neutral variable (e.g. getenv('STAGECOACH_ENV')).

rules.title: Acquia Cloud Hooks
rules.fix: Port post-code-deploy / post-db-copy hook scripts to Stagecoach post-deploy hooks (drush deploy, cache rebuild, sanitization).

rules.title: Acquia Pipelines config
rules.fix: Rebuild the pipeline as a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and pushes an image.

rules.title: Acquia BLT
rules.fix: BLT's build and deploy tasks assume Acquia's build-artifact workflow. Move them to composer scripts and a Docker build.

rules.title: Acquia settings packages
rules.fix: These packages wire in Acquia-specific settings. Replace them with settings.stagecoach.php.

rules.title: Acquia Connector
rules.fix: Uninstall after cutover.

rules.title: Acquia Purge (Varnish/Platform CDN)
rules.fix: Replace with Purge plus a CDN purger (Cloudflare, CloudFront, Fastly) or Varnish with cache-tag invalidation.

rules.title: Acquia Search
rules.fix: Set up Solr (in-cluster or hosted) or OpenSearch, point the Search API server at it, and reindex before cutover.

rules.title: Acquia Cloud Site Factory
rules.fix: Site Factory fleets need their own per-site migration plan. Scope this separately.

rules.title: Hardcoded Acquia file-system paths
rules.fix: Point file_public_path / file_private_path at a mounted volume or S3 (s3fs) instead of /mnt/gfs or /mnt/files.

rules.title: Memcache cache backend
rules.fix: Run memcached in-cluster (or ElastiCache), or switch to Redis (drupal/redis).

rules.title: Redis cache backend
rules.fix: Run Redis (in-cluster or a managed service) and pass connection details as env vars.

rules.title: Search API Solr
rules.fix: Needs a reachable Solr service. Budget the config-set upload and reindex.

rules.title: SimpleSAMLphp single sign-on
rules.fix: Move SimpleSAMLphp config and certificates into a Secret. If hostnames change, re-register the SP/ACS URL with the IdP.

rules.title: No SMTP / mail-API module
rules.fix: Containers usually have no local MTA, so PHP mail() will fail. Add Symfony Mailer (or an SMTP / API module) and configure a transport.

rules.title: Private file system configured
rules.fix: Private files need a persistent volume (ReadWriteMany) or a private S3 bucket.

rules.title: Files already on object storage
rules.fix: Good news: no file-system migration needed, just re-point credentials.
